text:
julia: Quick follow-up from the design review 1 key creation UX. Keeping thread short. Goals: streamline create flow, make copy affordances clearer, tighten empty state examples, and cover a11y for show-secret + toasts. Fig link in the doc.

mike: love the simplified create flow. one ask: can we let users pick a scope preset (read/write/embed) inline so they don't have to open a modal?

julia: yes  propose small segmented control inside the create drawer: Presets: Developer (Read), App (Read + Embed), Admin. default to Developer. show a tiny tooltip: "Presets pick common scopes; you can customize later."

aisha: copy note: when someone creates a key we currently show a long snip of the secret and a bland paragraph. new copy should be concise: "This is the only time you'll see this secret. Copy and store it now." Add one-line link under it: "Save to secrets manager" leading to docs.

emma: UX nit: the copy action is a tiny icon on the right of the secret. it's easy to miss. propose a primary CTA group: [Copy secret] [Download .env] and a small icon button for more actions. Keeps copy visible.

dan: accessibility: make the Copy button labelled "Copy secret to clipboard" and fire a polite aria-live message "API key copied". do not shift focus to toast. also ensure the show-secret toggle has aria-expanded and updates an aria-live region: "Secret revealed" / "Secret hidden".

julia: agreed. another small idea: show an example curl snippet in the empty state and the create success panel, so new users can test quickly. like: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
```

aisha: yes, that helped in other flows. empty state heading: "No API keys yet" CTA: "Create your first key" Subcopy: "API keys allow your services and scripts to call the Redwood API securely. Try it with the curl example below." Keep the illustration decorative (alt="").

emma: mobile: ensure the primary copy button is full-width and near the bottom safe area when the secret is revealed so thumbs can reach it.

dan: small security note: the one-time secret should be stored only in-memory on the client; avoid writing to logs. add a short microcopy line: "Redwood will not retain this value."

mike: dev follow-up: we can add a keyboard-first flow: focusing the key list and pressing 'c' opens create drawer. show a small hint label: "Press c to create" in the header. scope the shortcut to the keys page.

julia: final tiny copy tweak for revoke confirmation: change generic "Are you sure?" to: "Revoking this key will immediately stop services using it. This action cannot be undone." Buttons: Cancel (neutral), Revoke key (danger). Include link: "View Audit logs" in the modal footer.

aisha: i'll consolidate final strings and post them here by EOD. dan will run a quick a11y pass on the new drawer and toasts. mike will prototype the keyboard shortcut. emma will validate mobile placement.

julia: thanks all 688 will update figma with the preset control and new CTAs.
